findings.claim: The guard does not tie the page or the script's wiki directory to the project the classifier was launched for. Edit/Write is allowed on any clean absolute path ending in /docs/wiki/evidence.md, and Bash on any clean absolute <root>/docs/wiki. An injected finding can make the classifier write rows into another repository's evidence page; S7 injects level-2+ rows of that page into the builder's and reviewer's prompts, so an injected rule would reach another project's prompts. The hook has CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in its environment and cwd in its input, so the verb could pass the root into Call and require equality.
